description: Read-only workflows for finding, verifying, comparing, and composing open-source AI projects; live evidence requires the separately configured MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Research workflows for open-source AI projects
interface.longDescription: Structure project research, comparison, and stack planning while keeping facts, recommendations, unknowns, and risks separate. Connect the companion read-only MCP server before claiming live verified project or license facts.
defaultPrompt: Find open-source AI projects that meet my deployment, license, and technical constraints. If the live tools are unavailable, give me the requirements and verification checklist instead of inventing facts.
Compare Dify and RAGFlow for an enterprise knowledge-base use case, clearly separating verified facts from assumptions.
Design a self-hosted open-source AI stack and mark every unverified compatibility or license condition.
